pamphlet_excerpts: Safe Ladder Climbing Technique: When climbing, face the ladder and use both hands, don'tcarry anything in your hands (p. 10).
Preventing Ladder Tipping Hazards: Don't overreach when you are on a ladder, as it may tip and fall (p. 10).
Respiratory Protection for Toxins: Use a special respirator when working with toxic substances (p. 10).
Flammable Chemical Container Storage: Keep the containers tightly closed and away from heat or flames (p. 10).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Wear a Special Respirator: Use a special respirator when working with toxic substances (p. 10).
Step 2 - Seal and Store Containers: Keep the containers tightly closed and away from heat or flames (p. 10).
Step 3 - Verify Underwriters Laboratories Listing: They should be listed with Underwriters Laboratories, a safety testing and certification organization (p. 10).
Step 4 - Identify Potential Asbestos Materials: Asbestos is a mineral fiber that has been used for many years in some building construction materials for insulation and as a fire-retardant (p. 10).

quiz_item.scenario_prompt: Before replacing a leaking compression faucet washer or repairing a damaged electrical wall switch for Home Repairs Requirement 1, what safety step is required first?
quiz_item.question: Before replacing a leaking compression faucet washer or repairing a damaged electrical wall switch for Home Repairs Requirement 1, what safety step is required first?
options: A. Open the faucet handle all the way so water pressure flushes the pipe while you unscrew the valve stem.

B. Shut off the fixture or main water supply valve (and relieve line pressure) before disassembling plumbing, or switch off the specific circuit breaker at the service panel and verify the wires are dead with a non-contact voltage tester before touching electrical terminals.
C. Tape the wall toggle switch in the 'off' position with masking tape and work on the live brass terminal screws with bare fingers.
D. Stand on the top cap of a folding step ladder while leaning two feet outside the side rails to reach an overhead ceiling fixture.

Matching Nap to Texture: Generally, the rougher the surface you are painting, the longer the nap you should use (p. 45).
Painting Stucco and Concrete: The longer nap makes it possible to work paint into irregular surfaces such as concrete block and highly textured walls like stucco (p. 45).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Select Longer Nap Covers: Generally, the rougher the surface you are painting, the longer the nap you should use (p. 45).
Step 2 - Work Paint Into Crevices: The longer nap makes it possible to work paint into irregular surfaces such as concrete block and highly textured walls like stucco (p. 45).
Step 3 - Use Short Nap Indoors: The smoother the surface you are painting, and the smoother the finish you want, the shorter the nap you should use (p. 45).
Step 4 - Check for Lead Paint: Lead-based paint can cause serious health problems (p. 45).

B. Paint the slats with alkyd enamel while the blind is still hanging in the window
C. Cut all cords at once with wire cutters so the slats drop onto the floor
D. Carefully sketch the existing cord routing path through the pulleys and slats
choices: A. Soak the top pulley mechanism in warm soapy water to loosen the staples
B. Paint the slats with alkyd enamel while the blind is still hanging in the window
C. Cut all cords at once with wire cutters so the slats drop onto the floor
D. Carefully sketch the existing cord routing path through the pulleys and slats
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: D. Carefully sketch the existing cord routing path through the pulleys and slats
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (D): Because window blinds differ in how they are constructed, sketching the cord path before removing the old cords ensures you can thread the new cord properly (p. 66).

patrol_quiz_bank.question: When researching a career or hobby in residential painting and renovation, why is knowing the age of a home important before sanding or scraping walls?
options: A. Older homes may have lead-based paint that can cause serious health problems
B. Older plaster walls can only be painted with a 1 3/4 inch roller nap
C. Paint rollers cannot be used on walls built more than twenty years ago
D. Older homes do not require primer or surface cleaning before repainting
choices: A. Older homes may have lead-based paint that can cause serious health problems
B. Older plaster walls can only be painted with a 1 3/4 inch roller nap
C. Paint rollers cannot be used on walls built more than twenty years ago
D. Older homes do not require primer or surface cleaning before repainting
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: A. Older homes may have lead-based paint that can cause serious health problems
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (A): Older homes often contain lead-based paint, which poses serious health hazards to trades people and hobbyists if disturbed without proper safety precautions (p. 45).
